versions.subject: feat: general updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_wmic:
    - Image|endswith: '\wbem\WMIC.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\winword.exe'
        - '\excel.exe'
        - '\powerpnt.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'process'
        - 'create'
        - 'call'
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Add more suspicious LOLBINs as you see fit
        - 'regsvr32'
        - 'rundll32'
        - 'msiexec'
        - 'mshta'
        - 'verclsid'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wbem\\WMIC.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wmic.exe" ParentImage IN ("*\\winword.exe", "*\\excel.exe", "*\\powerpnt.exe") CommandLine="*process*" CommandLine="*create*" CommandLine="*call*" CommandLine IN ("*regsvr32*", "*rundll32*", "*msiexec*", "*mshta*", "*verclsid*")
